PLATO (PLAnetary Transits and Oscillations of stars) is the European Space Agency (ESA)
M3 (medium-class) astronomical science mission for the search of exo-planets. This is per-formed by detecting and characterizing transit signature of exo-planets in front of the parent
star, as well as measuring seismic oscillations of central stars of exo-planetary systems and
other selected stars. For this purpose, PLATO will be placed in an orbit around the L2 La-grange point of the Sun-Earth system. The mission schedule considers a launch in 2026. The operational lifetime is 6.5 years.

The objective of this procurement is the manufacturing and test of the Service Valves for the Chemical Propulsion Subsystem (CPPS) for the PLATO program.
